searchText: make a footnote in the spec: `unions were an early experimental feature removed from the spec in commit xyz` Aren’t Unions already supported in Rust, GoLang, TypeScript, Nim, and C# Ssz libraries? (Could be supported in more, I am just aware of Ssz Unions being used in those languages) I am aware of Unions being difficult to implement using GoLang generics, but are there examples of Unions being difficult to implement in other languages? We do not have support for unions yet, and hopefully we do not need to add it Don't know about other libraries, but our fork of fastssz last I checked did not have them And I think the methodical ssz library that Kasey's finishing for Prysm also doesn't have them either Java is difficult similarly to Go > delay Ssz adoption By adoption are you exclusively talking about execution layer client’s adopting Ssz or any protocol adopting Ssz in general? EL adopting SSZ so that we can prove against the htr in the CL and use it in the engine API
